newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BATH AXE ENGLAND TRIO FOR EURO CUP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BATH AXE ENGLAND TRIO FOR EURO CUP.

text.p: England rugby union champions Bath have dropped three English internationals, including full-back Jon Callard, for Saturday's European Cup quarter-final against Cardiff at the Arms Park.
Callard, the club's top points-scorer this season, makes way for Wigan rugby league player Jason Robinson, while tight-head prop John Mallett and flanker Andy Robinson also miss out.
In all, there are eight changes from the side beaten 9-6 by first division rivals Northampton last weekend.

Also dropped are scrum-half Charlie Harrison, loose-head prop Kevin Yates and lock Brian Cusack, with hooker Graham Dawe (dislocated elbow) and flanker Richard Webster (fractured knuckle) out through injury.

Scottish international Andy Nicol replaces Harrison and his half-back partner Mike Catt will assume the goalkicking duties in Callard's absence, giving him an ideal opportunity before carrying out that role for England against Italy on Saturday week.

In the pack Dave Hilton, Gareth Adams and Victor Ubogu form a new-look front row, while a different back-row combination sees Wales Under-21 prospect Nathan Thomas and Steve Ojomoh packing down either side of Scotland No 8 Eric Peters.
Bath's Cardiff-born lock Nigel Redman faces a late fitness test on the groin injury which has sidelined him for three weeks, placing Ireland A man Cusack on stand-by.
